1.d4 d5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 c5 4.cxd5 cxd4 5.Q.strategy: Returns the queen to d1, where it defends d5 together with the knight and avoids further tempo-gaining attacks. White has spent two queen moves on a pawn and now has to catch up in development against Black's active pieces.
Recaptures the pawn and opens the diagonal for the c8-bishop, which can attack the queen if White takes on d5. Black plays for rapid development against a White army that is still mostly at home.
